exposure: fetal heart rate pattern (persistent bradycardia, decelerations without bradycardia, normal fetal heart rate)
cohort: The cohort consisted of women with singleton pregnancies complicated by umbilical cord prolapse during labor between 1995 and 2018.
finding: There was a significant inverse correlation between the bradycardia-to-delivery interval and cord arterial pH and base excess in cases of umbilical cord prolapse with fetal bradycardia, but not with the decision-to-delivery interval or in cases with other fetal heart rate patterns.
